name: Wyrmtouched Brawler (CR 4)
body:
Wyrmtouched Brawler
CR 4

XP 1,200
Wyrmtouched brawler (breath savant) 5
NG Female Medium humanoid (dragonkin)
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 10, flat-footed 17 (+5 armor, +1 nat, +1 shield)
hp 48 (5d10+20)
Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +3; +2 vs. sleep and paralysis
Defensive Abilities Resist 5 fire

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +8 (1d8+4) or mwk dagger +9 (1d4+3, 19-20/x2)
Ranged mwk light crossbow +6 (1d8, 19-20/x2) or dagger +5 (1d4+3, 19-20/x2)
Special Attacks draconic breath weapon (2d8+3 fire damage, DC 15 Reflex for half)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 10, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 11
Base Atk +5; CMB +7 ; CMD 17
Feats Breath Weapon Artisan, Careful Breath Weapon, Combat Breath Weapon, Enigmatic Origin, Expanded Breath Weapon, Potent Breath Weapon, Toughness, Unbound Breath Weapon
Skills Handle Animal +8, Heal +10, Perception +12, Sense Motive +10
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ Brawler’s cunning, breath’s fury, consistent breath, dragon scales, fang strike, melee breath, mutable breath, razor fang, torrent breath
Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds (4), potion of invisibility; Other Gear +1 chain shirt, crossbow bolt (50), dagger (5), explorer’s outfit, healer’s kit (2), ink (3), ink pen (2), journal (3), masterwork backpack, masterwork buckler, masterwork dagger, masterwork light crossbow, potion of endure elements, small tent, trail rations (20), waterskin, 112 gp, 6 sp
